paper.title_en: Photon Gas Thermodynamics in Doubly Special Relativity at the Planck Scale
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamics of a photon gas within the Magueijo-Smolin formulation of doubly special relativity, a framework that augments the speed of light with an observer-independent energy scale of the order of the Planck energy. We derive the logarithmic grand partition function, and the complete set of thermodynamic quantities for the photon gas, including the Helmholtz free energy, internal energy, entropy, pressure, and heat capacity, and perform their numerical evaluation. Our results smoothly reduce to the conventional special relativistic expressions in the limit where the invariant energy scale tends to infinity. For temperatures approaching the Planck scale, the finite cutoff induces a systematic suppression of all thermodynamic functions relative to their standard special-relativistic counterparts.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 论文主要研究光子气体在双狭义相对论中的热力学性质，未涉及黑洞热力学、脉冲星计时阵列、凝聚态全息或广义相对论基础等核心主题，与当前研究方向不匹配。
decision.title_zh: 普朗克尺度下双狭义相对论中的光子气体热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了Magueijo-Smolin形式的双狭义相对论中光子气体的热力学，该框架在光速的基础上增加了一个与观察者无关的能量尺度，其量级为普朗克能量。我们推导了对数巨配分函数，以及光子气体的完整热力学量集合，包括亥姆霍兹自由能、内能、熵、压强和热容量，并进行了数值评估。在不变能量尺度趋于无穷大的极限下，我们的结果平滑地退化为传统的狭义相对论表达式。当温度接近普朗克尺度时，有限截断导致所有热力学函数相对于标准狭义相对论对应项出现系统性抑制。
